author: reek
body: A function that performs less than it was asked for is safe to hand over. writer performs Console.Write; apply-it asks for anything Console. The def boundary has always allowed this direction -- a [Console] def may perform Console.Write -- but the argument boundary compared rows for equality and turned this program away with CDX2090. That was the defect, and it turned away a program that could not go wrong: apply-it already promised its own caller it might do something Console-ish, and writing is something Console-ish.

author: reek
body: The counterpart, that the unsafe direction is still refused, is pinned by errors/effect-widen-arg-deny. Both are needed: a check that only ever says yes is not a check.
